notes:
Summary: Penumbra builds an enterprise e-discovery platform for regulated financial services and healthcare law firms. They need an embeddings + reranking RAG stack inside a customer-managed VPC or on-prem to meet data residency and legal hold requirements. Key asks: scale to 30-50M indexed docs, sub-200ms median retrieval latency for top-k, configurable cross-encoder reranking for high-precision searches, and cost targets under $0.01/query for typical searches.

Call snippets / customer voice: "We cannot tolerate vendor access to raw PII; everything must stay in our VPC and audit logs must be tamper-evident."  (CTO). "If your reranker costs multiply our per-query bill then we won't be able to keep this in prod; show us cost controls and fallbacks." (Head of Product).

Security & compliance notes: SOC2 required; ISO27001 preferred; KMS integration mandatory; retention controls for legal hold (7+ years); audit logging retention and export for third-party litigation holds. Data residency: primary in us-east-1, with EU enclave option for EU customers.

POC scope agreed: 6-week POC — ingest ~1.2M docs first week (sanitized set), scale tests up to 10M during week 3, and a final scale run to 30M+ if initial numbers look good. Two evaluation axes: (1) cost per query at production QPS, (2) precision/recall with candidate set sizes and reranker strategy.

Tech constraints and preferences: Prefer embeddings-based ANN index (HNSW or IVF) plus a lightweight reranker (DistilCrossEncoder for cost) with optional dense-to-sparse fusion. Want transparent token-level cost reporting in Console. Must support retention locks / exportable immutable audit logs (S3 + write-once policies).

Recent interactions: 2026-01-18 intro call (ff_2026-01-18_4410) — overview + high-level requirements. 2026-02-10 security deep-dive (ff_2026-02-10_7721) — architecture questions, KMS key policy drafts shared. 2026-02-20 demo: embeddings + rerank prototype with 100k docs (internal demo using hosted sandbox). Security team requested an on-prem deployment runbook.

Commercial sensitivity: Highly cost-sensitive at scale; wants predictable reserved commit for dedicated GPUs if we can prove <0.007/query at their target throughput.

Stated non-functional SLOs: 95th percentile latency < 400ms for compound queries (embedding + rerank), median < 150ms; availability target 99.95% for production endpoints.

Decision process: CTO/Security -> Head of Product -> Procurement. Procurer indicated procurement window May 2026 pending POC results.
